_comment: Single source of truth for the matched W1 parameters of B0, B1 and B2. Read by the Foundry tests (test/W1Base.sol) and by the live runner (experiments/workloads/w1/config.py). wei/token values are decimal strings. Changing any value after a result is reported requires a docs/decision-log.md entry.

fees._comment: One fee policy for every transaction and every UserOperation in every baseline. The runner pins each block's base fee to base_fee_per_gas, so the effective price is min(max_fee, base_fee + priority) = 2 gwei everywhere.

eoa_tx_gas_limits._comment: Fixed (not estimated) gas limits for plain transactions. b0_action is the recipient EOA's ERC-20 transfer; the sender's ETH allowance for B0 is exactly b0_action * max_fee_per_gas.

userop._comment: Identical account-side limits for B1 and B2, fixed before any reported result from calibration runs on 2026-09-14 (docs/decision-log.md): B1 validation (deploy + signature + prefund payment) needs between 200k and 250k gas and B2 validation under 200k, so 300k is one shared value with margin; account execution uses ~34k gas, and 60k stays within EntryPoint v0.9.0 PENALTY_GAS_THRESHOLD (40k) so no 10% unused-execution-gas penalty is charged (80k incurred a 4,601-gas penalty in both B1 and B2). B2 additionally carries a paymaster verification limit; its postOp limit is 0 because ObservablePaymaster has no postOp. preVerificationGas is a fixed policy value of the in-repo bundler, not a calldata-cost estimate. B1's native funding is exactly the EntryPoint required prefund: (verification + call + preVerification) * max_fee_per_gas.

funding._comment: Setup-phase ETH from the local faucet (anvil dev account 0). Not part of W1 workflow cost; recorded separately.
